notes.title: TQD REFORGED (in Germany!)
notes.notes:
[h1]Huuuuuge update AND a new event![/h1][p]The Quizard's Domain has been [b]engoodened[/b] yet again.[/p][p]I should start posting actual patch notes, probably... 
I'll start being all professional soon, I promise. [/p][p][/p][p]At this point though, it's been a while and a ton has changed, so this will have to do for now:[/p][h2]Everything is better[/h2][p]Almost literally! It's [i]barely[/i] even an exaggeration ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]The star of the show is a series of big visual updates I've lovingly been calling the [b]literal[/b] [b]glow-up[/b], like a total dork, because it includes a bunch of fancy new lighting and light-based vfx![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/ef4b55aacfe49cf786810e5b19d41c8aa11cf748.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Other cool new things include, but are not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Even juicier character interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Snappier, more exciting physics[/p][/*][*][p]All-new visual and sound effects across the board[/p][/*][*][p]A new crown mechanic, painting a bulls-eye on the lead player(s) in matches[/p][/*][*][p]Extra quality of life in a bunch of areas[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Made in Germany[/h2][p]I'm very proud to have been selected as a featured game in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged in Germany Event[/url][/p][p]You'll know what it's all about just from the name, so I'll just add that it's an honor to be in there with some truly amazing games from my home country.[/p][p]Wanna freshen up your German knowledge in honor of the big event?
Don't forget that you can select German vocabulary quiz categories in both the main and quick play menus![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/5b325368b08a1c835cbc238e01d09a09c376160b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]v0.9.9i is out RIGHT NOW on all branches of the core app and demo. [/p][p]Please give it a try and share your honest thoughts![/p][p][/p][p]And as always, maaassive thanks to everyone who continues to support me and my vision for this game.
Y'all are awesome and I couldn't do any of this without you 💜[/p][p]- Julian[/p]

notes.title: The Demo Hath Returned
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3032770/The_Quizards_Domain__Demo/



Hey folks!
In case you missed it: The Quizard's Domain demo is once again playable, right now, as part of Steam's Couch Co-Op fest! 
Grab some friends (or bots, no one's judging) and peep all the cool new stuff I've been cooking up.
Also: The demo now has its own page, so if you get a chance, [b]please leave a review[/b] as that will help out immensely.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/aeec6523573c7eaf115dd8fe017b471273ac6e76.png[/img]


[h2]New Arena: Voracious Void[/h2]
This thing has all the newses! 
New domain/biome (Domain of Terror), new game mode ([b]Co-Op boss fight[/b]), new visuals and audio!
Fight a horde of mischievous demons on their home turf, navigating the broken-down Void Temple to slam the [i]wrong[/i] answers with your light attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/195f5d81b0bf0068986139cc99b338ee450ad5a4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/28ea2ef497bce07f7d75f26808a582251031df9c.gif[/img]


[h2]Yes, Light Attacks![/h2]
You read that correctly - ALL playable characters now have access to a shared set of light attacks (up, neutral/side, down).
They serve as common ground between the growing roster, and will be interchangeable as part of a loadout selection in the future. 
You will be able to combine different attack types with each character to really nail down your own personal playstyle and complement characters' abilities.



[h2]Speaking of Abilities[/h2]
Every character will have access to an up, neutral/side, and down special ability, just like light attacks.
Inspired by platform fighters like Smash Bros and Brawlhalla, this full set of light and special moves should give each character a fun set of tools for messing with friends and reaching your goals.
The up and neutral/side specials are available for all characters now, down specials will be added in the coming days with a focus on defense and counterplay.



[h2]Menu/Lobby Overhaul[/h2]
I want every part of this game to be as fun as it possibly can - and now, that includes the menus!
There is still some polish missing here and there, but I'm proud to present a bunch of all-new ways to try out new characters and have fun together while matches are set up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/3bc0530e598ef34441a4ca89e88ae44c7e7c67a0.gif[/img]

[h2]Game More Betterer[/h2]
Too many things have changed to list them all, but here's a quick overview:
- Across the board, all characters, interactions and physics have been updated to be snappier and more exciting
- Performance on lower end PCs has been improved
- Bugs. So many bugs. Squished and yeeted unto the void.



[h2]Thank You!![/h2]

[h3]To everyone who continues to support me and the game:
You're the absolute best 💜 [/h3]

---

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3032770/The_Quizards_Domain__Demo/

notes.title: 🐸 RRRRRIBBIT!!!
notes.notes:
[h2]🐸🐸🐸 Welcome to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/spelkollektivet/sale/froggy-sale]Froggy Sale[/url]! 🐸🐸🐸
Big thanks to fellow indies [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/spelkollektivet] Spelkollektivet[/url] for hosting this fun, frog-themed event[/h2]

[h1]New Playable Character: Roger![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/0d7f6055018e92128e4e4fe1d6fdf3e4542c5d8a.gif[/img]

[b]In honor of the big event, the fourth playable character has hopped his way into the demo (and soon, all of your hearts!).
Roger's froggy legs may not be made for running, but boy do they let him JUMP!
Zip around the arenas and reach new heights by combining Roger's aerial prowess and his sticky Grapple Tongue ability - either pulling him to the environment, or unwitting opponents to him!
Our bouncy new friend will continue to improve and possibly gain more abilities based on player feedback in the coming days.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/3a3eb60882d8d7d96bc871413bcf7cfcd0189810.gif[/img]

[h2]Balance and Quality of Life[/h2]
There will be further improvements to the game over the course of the week, and quite a few have made it into the current version already!
For example, all characters have had a tune-up, becoming faster and more agile, as I continue to strive for a fun and balanced play experience with every single one of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/4c95506260bbf78eb24d62079fe6b10c6d54eb97.gif[/img]

[h2]Gratitude![/h2]
Once again, I am hugely grateful to all of you for your continued support on this journey!
And as always, please free to share any and all thoughts, or submit new questions to be added to the game, over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/QHbbDuUCa7]Official Discord Server![/url]

notes.title: I'M IN TINY TEAMS 2024!
notes.notes:
I'm absolutely thrilled to announce that The Quizard's Domain is part of this year's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]Tiny Teams Festival[/url]!

It's a fantastic event showcasing solo developers and very small teams, that has been steadily growing in popularity year over year! 
The Festival is organized by the wonderful folks at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/yogscastgames]Yogscast Games[/url], and I will forever be grateful that they selected [b]my game[/b] out of [b]1600+ submissions this year!![/b]

They even chose it as one of the very first games to kick off the Festival this year!!

[b]The fun begins at 02;06;50 [/b]in the video:

[previewyoutube=wZus1pAHFyQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Special Content Drop[/h2]
To show my love and appreciation for this incredible opportunity, I have made [b]two permanent additions to the in-game quiz categories[/b], available through [b]Quick Play[/b] (more on that below) as well as the Category Settings menu in [b]custom matches[/b]:
[list]
[*][h3]The Yogscast[/h3]
A set of questions all about the history, achievements, and hijinks of the very awesome people who have made all this possible, The Yogscast!
[*][h3]Tiny Teams 2024[/h3]
A unique category including questions about many of the other amazing, creative games that are part of this year's festival!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/a933acf24ae6544991bf6c7f616ed2d58fc876b4.gif[/img]

[h2]Big Demo Update[/h2]
On top of this special content, the demo has also received a sizeable set of updates, including but not limited to:
[list]
[*][b]Moving CPU Players![/b] Don't have friends handy to play with? Add a practice dummy or 3
[*][b]Quick Play![/b] Jump right into the action ASAP and choose to randomize some match elements
[*][b]Anemotes![/b] Express yourself while tearing through the opposition with these fun animated emotes
[*][b]Soul State![/b] Mess with others as a soul ball whenever you don't have a live character in the arena
[*][b]Balance![/b] Just about every set of numbers has been tweaked to improve the entire experience
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000996/4c95506260bbf78eb24d62079fe6b10c6d54eb97.gif[/img]

[h2]Gratitude![/h2]
Once again, I am hugely grateful to the tiny team making Tiny Teams possible, and to all of you for your continued support on this journey!

Special thanks go to my dear friend [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/purplemosscollectors?curator_clanid=9730205]Purple Moss Collectors[/url], who has helped guide me through my preparations and is a constant source of support.
He is releasing his own first commercial game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400510/Dungeons__Degenerate_Gamblers/]Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers[/url] alongside the Festival, and you should absolutely check it out RIGHT NOW!

💜

notes.title: Free Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Weeks of hard polishing work have finally paid off, as [b]the offical Quizard Demo is now live and available to everyone![/b][/h1]

[h3]What's part of the demo:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]3 playable characters[/b], with one more to join the Demo later on!
[*][b]4 fully playable Arenas[/b]!
[*][b]3.000 Trivia questions[/b], courtesy of the Open Trivia Database!
[*][b]10.000 German/English vocabulary questions[/b], with more languages coming soon!
[*]Be one of the first to try out the game's core mechanics, with up to 3 other friends locally, or online via [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b] (4 players total)!
[*][i]Immobile [/i]CPU players as punching bags, soon with basic intelligence!
[/list]

Like what you see?

[h3]Here's what you can expect from the full game:[/h3]
[list]
[*]More of everything: Characters, Arenas, Questions, Settings... All at an even higher higher level of quality!
[*]Custom question/answer sets, so you can create and share your own quizzes!
[*]All-new game modes, including co-op and single player!
[*]Dedicated online multiplayer!
[*]Exciting interactive elements for Streamers and their audience!
[*]And much, much more! 
[/list]

[h2]Get in touch by joining the game's official Discord server, where you can drop any feedback, suggestions, bug reports, or just some random thoughts.
I'd love to hear what you have to say about the Demo![/h2]

[h3]Huge thank you to everyone who's helped me get this far.
I can't wait to see where this journey will take us![/h3]

[h1]❤️[/h1]
